notes.title: Release 28/04/2023
notes.content:
Save The Date 28/04/2023!!!

After 8 months of development, it's finally time to release Version 1.0 of The Unfound Soul.

Update

New

 Character Level with Every Run


Improvements

 Improved Frame Rate
 There are too many Bug Fixes to list :>

notes.title: Update 0.1.0 Last Update Before Release
notes.content:
New Features:


 Artifacts now scale with your level, making them more powerful as you progress.
 The game now ends after you defeat the boss, giving you a clear objective to work towards.


Bug Fixes:


 Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in artifact combination, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.


Important Info:

Other than hotfixes, there will be no more updates until the release of Update 1.0.0.

notes.title: First Small Update
notes.content:
Update 0.0.1

Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue where players could not enter the last level
 Fixed issue where options were not being saved and loaded properly
 Fixed alignment issue with tracks on top left in fights


Added Functionality and Changes

 Reduces waiting time between effects playing
 Changed last fight to always be a boss fight
 Added simple boss fight
 Added new sound effects
 Removed decimal points from damage numbers
 Nerfed heal effect
